items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...his wife in California calls him Nicky a lot you know? A lot of them call him Nicky.

ctx.x: Yes, but everybody calls him that. But I never did call him Inesuki. And his wife in California calls him Nicky a lot you know? A lot of them call him Nicky.
